Class Pointcuts

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.aop.support.Pointcuts
public abstract class Pointcuts extends Object
Pointcut constants for matching getters and setters, and static methods useful for manipulating and evaluating pointcuts.

这些方法对于使用并集和交集方法组合点切面特别有用。

Author:
Rod Johnson，Juergen Hoeller
